{"arguments": {"content": "import sys
import openpyxl

src = sys.argv[1]
out = sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(src)
ws = wb["Pricing"]
pkg = wb["Package & Weight Data"]

# Data range in Package & Weight Data
nrows = 0
for r in range(2, pkg.max_row + 1):
    if pkg.cell(row=r, column=1).value is not None:
        nrows = r
last = nrows

A = f"'Package & Weight Data'!$A$2:$A${last}"
B = f"'Package & Weight Data'!$B$2:$B${last}"
C_ = f"'Package & Weight Data'!$C$2:$C${last}"
D = f"'Package & Weight Data'!$D$2:$D${last}"

# Formula for E{r}: match Package Type in C, weight D within range, return Price
for r in range(2, 6):
    ref_C = f"C{r}"
    ref_D = f"D{r}"
    formula = (
        f"=SUMPRODUCT(({A}={ref_C})*({B}<={ref_D})*({C_}>={ref_D})*{D})"
    )
    ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value = formula

wb.save(out)
print("saved", out)", "path": "/bench/answers/57445/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
